$comment: One description of the native-comment session ops and how each transport names them (issue #982). SessionOpDescriptionDriftTests checks every transport against it; see docs/architecture/session_op_descriptions.md. Argument names are the canonical wire names; a transport that spells one differently lists it under argNames, and a transport-specific default under defaults. Both are recorded divergences, not the target. An argument's own default is the one DocxSessionOps applies on every transport. This family has no divergences left: issue #1014 gave every transport one name and one default per argument. It is generated (issue #1027): tools/op-codegen emits the stdio host's and the MCP server's argument parsing, the MCP schema properties and the WASM [JSExport] shims from this file. The argument order is the facade's parameter order and the WASM shim's. A stdio deprecatedAliases entry is an old spelling the stdio host still accepts; mcp.<tool>.properties carries the schema prose for each property the tool advertises, in the order it advertises them; wasm.doc is the shim's XML summary.

anchorId.description: add: the body paragraph to comment on. Mutually exclusive with revisionId.

span.description: add: character range within the paragraph. Omit to comment on the whole block.

revisionId.description: add: alternatively, the id from docxodus_track_changes list. The exact live revision extent is targeted; unknown/already-resolved ids fail with revision_not_found.

date.description: add/reply: optional ISO-8601 timestamp; w:date is written only when provided (omitting keeps output deterministic).

markdown.description: add/reply/update: the comment body (same markdown subset as other payloads). Required for update; add and reply without it create an empty comment.

commentAnchorId.description: reply: parent comment; resolve/update/remove: target comment definition anchor (kind cmt).

resolved.description: resolve: true marks done (default); false reopens while preserving thread parentage.

wasm.doc: Add a native Word comment on body paragraph <paramref name="anchorId"/> (issue #300). <paramref name="spanJson"/> is <c>""</c> for the whole block or <c>{"start":int,"length":int}</c>; <paramref name="initials"/>/<paramref name="date"/> are <c>""</c> when absent (date is ISO-8601 and written only when provided). Returns the created definition anchor (kind <c>cmt</c>) plus its <c>p</c>/scope-<c>cmt</c> paragraph anchors in <c>created</c>.
Add a native Word comment around the exact live extent of a tracked revision. Unknown or already-resolved ids return <c>revision_not_found</c>.
Add a native reply with an adjacent reference; <c>w15:paraIdParent</c> links it to the immediate parent so it inherits the thread root's range.
Set <c>w15:done</c> for one comment (<c>false</c> reopens it), creating the paraId-keyed metadata parts when the comment was previously flat.
Replace a comment's body text, addressed by its definition anchor (kind <c>cmt</c>); identity attributes (author/initials/date) are preserved.
Remove a comment: definition + body marker triple + threading entries.
The document's comments in part order: <c>[{"anchorId","author","initials"?,"date"?,"text","parentAnchorId"?,"resolved"?}]</c>.
